capabilities: Send notes to AI agents as rich markdown
Attach linked note context to agent input
extras: README is in Chinese and mostly describes the monorepo layout (packages/obsidian-plugin, packages/remote, packages/core) rather than plugin usage; it points to a separate first-use guide and architecture note for the R&D automation orchestration MVP. Installable releases must bundle platform-specific native PTY and Iroh runtime libraries alongside main.js, manifest.json and styles.css.
problem: AI chat plugins in Obsidian usually pass only a single prompt box, so the note's markdown structure and its linked context are lost.
summary: Obsidian plugin that hands notes to AI agents as rich markdown with linked context, via local and remote terminal sessions.
